purpose: Determine whether chess-specialized checkpoints provide a reproducible improvement over the existing general-purpose control without weakening factual commentary or operational reliability.

hypotheses.claim: At matched inference budgets, at least one chess-specialized candidate will improve board-state and move-policy metrics over loops-cpu-gpt-oss-20b.
Chess specialization alone will not guarantee faithful natural-language explanations; commentary factuality must be measured independently.

A verified hybrid route combining deterministic board tooling or engine evidence with a chess-language generator will outperform an unaided single-model route on coverage at a fixed factual-error ceiling.

fixed_conditions.position_identity: same position IDs and source groups for every runnable model
fixed_conditions.information_boundary: The existing no-forward-input packet remains mandatory for commentary generation. No principal variation, post-move state, answer move, future feature, or solution label may reach the generator.

stages.name: provenance_and_runtime
stages.promotion_rule: All required outputs exist and no unresolved redistribution or execution restriction blocks testing.

stages.name: ChessQA_diagnostics
stages.promotion_rule: Report all categories and representations. No aggregate-only promotion; structural and protocol failures remain visible.

stages.name: raw_legality_and_state_tracking
stages.promotion_rule: Raw and legality-masked results are both reported. A legality mask cannot erase evidence of a model's own board-state failures.

stages.name: move_quality
stages.reference: Stockfish with pinned version, binary hash, nodes, threads, hash, and score point of view
stages.promotion_rule: Compare matched position families with cluster-aware intervals; do not convert a small sample to Elo.

stages.name: no_forward_commentary
stages.promotion_rule: Use the repository's existing capability gate. A model that plays stronger chess but hallucinates board facts is not promoted as a commentator.

stages.name: hybrid_ablation
stages.promotion_rule: Prefer the least complex condition whose clustered confidence interval meets the factuality gate and materially improves coverage.

decision_rule.pre_registration: Freeze candidate revisions, prompts, position splits, engine settings, and promotion thresholds before running the held-out test split.
decision_rule.minimum_claim: A candidate may be called better only for the measured capability whose paired, cluster-aware interval supports the improvement.
decision_rule.production_promotion: Requires project-benchmarked evidence, resolved license status, reproducible runtime receipts, and passage of the no-forward commentary gate. Upstream claims alone never qualify.
